_: The court's pace (court.js). stages: by the share of the reign's clock gone (until), the seasons between full sittings (every) and how many matters a sitting hears, as [count, chance] pairs (want). noClock: a reign without a clock. petitions: the reign's petitions setting shifts every and want (rare: fewer, more seldom; often: more, sooner), within wantMin..wantMax. handYear: seasons between the Hand calling the King in for a crisis between sittings (an ultimatum always comes). favourWords: how a ruling's result names a house's change, in words and never numbers (the direction-not-arithmetic rule): a move of at least big points is 'much'. one: one matter at a time (PLAN.md Phase 1; Frostpunk's one law at a time): with it on (or a reign's options.oneAtATime) the court sits for one matter a season, never more, with chance by the stage of the reign (until, as stages); a crisis or ultimatum goes first and the rest wait for the next season, so matters are spread through the reign, never in clumps. rulingDue: seasons until a lord comes back about a ruling (favourbook.js).

voices._: Two councillors speak on every matter (court.js voices; KoDP's council, CK3's councillors): the Hand, a lord of the great house warmest to the crown, urges the answer that warms his own house most or cools the house his lord likes least, under a pretext (one of pretexts, by the matter); the Steward, a crown officer, urges a different answer, the cheapest the treasury can pay, then the one that warms the most houses. hand and steward are their titles; free, warms and dear the Steward's lines ({label}, {n} houses, {cost} gold).
pretexts: For the crown's good name, Sire
If the realm is to hold, Sire
As your father would have, Sire
voices.free: It costs the treasury nothing, Sire: {label}.
voices.warms: {label}, Sire. It warms {n} houses for {cost} gold.
voices.dear: {label}, Sire. The treasury can bear {cost} gold.
